88.name: TerminalInput
88.docs:
Interactive terminal input.
Uses dialoguer arrow-key selection when stdin is a TTY.
Falls back to line-based input when stdin is piped.

When `history_file` is set, `prompt_text` saves and restores history across
sessions using rustyline (arrow-key navigation + Ctrl-R reverse search).

150.name: InitResult
150.docs:
Result of a successful init: the config and optional baseline metrics
(present when a config validator was provided and succeeded).

36.name: into
36.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

136.name: build_init_prompt
136.docs:
Build the system prompt for the init agent.

Includes the XML protocol schema, config section descriptions, and
instructions for exploring the codebase before proposing config.

83.name: UserInput
83.docs:
Trait for user interaction during the init conversation.
Implementations handle text prompts, option selection, and approval.

82.name: prompt_approve
82.docs: Show a yes/no approval prompt. Returns true if approved.

144.name: ConfigValidator
144.docs:
Callback to validate a proposed config before finalizing.

Called after the user approves the assembled config. Typically runs the
measure commands and tries metric extraction. Returns extracted metrics
on success, or a detailed error string (including measure output) on failure.

93.name: MockInput
93.docs: Simple input for testing. Always returns the same response.

80.name: prompt_select
80.docs:
Show a question with selectable options. Returns the selected option's key
or a free-text response.

79.name: prompt_text
79.docs: Show a message and read a free-form text response.

166.name: run_init
166.docs:
Run the agent-assisted init conversation.

`user_input` handles all user interaction (text prompts, option selection, approval).
Use `TerminalInput` for real CLI sessions or `MockInput` for testing.

If `config_validator` is provided, it is called after user approval to validate the
config (e.g., by running a trial measure). On failure, the user is asked whether
to let the agent revise the config.
